author: Business Standard Companies Desk
headline: Mumbai-based Mintoak acquires ICC Loyalty to deepen presence in West Asia
snippet: Mintoak, the Mumbai-headquartered merchant payments SaaS platform, has acquired Dubai-based loyalty technology company ICC Loyalty as it looks to deepen its presence in the West Asian market and expand beyond payments into customer engagement and rewards.

author: Inc42 Newsdesk
headline: Mintoak Acquires UAE-Based ICC Loyalty To Expand Fintech Stack For Banks
snippet: The acquisition will help Mintoak's banking partners unlock new revenue opportunities beyond payments, with the combined business generating over $30 million in annual revenue at a profitability margin exceeding 30%.

author: PR Newswire
headline: Mintoak acquires Middle East-headquartered fintech ICC Loyalty
snippet: Mintoak announced today it has acquired ICC Loyalty, expanding its footprint across the Middle East, Africa, Eastern Europe and Asia while helping banks unlock new revenue opportunities beyond payments.

author: PR Newswire APAC
headline: Visa and Mintoak Join Forces to Bring Merchant SaaS Capabilities to Acquirers Across Asia Pacific
snippet: Visa announced a partnership with Mintoak, a merchant SaaS fintech platform, to enable acquirers across Asia Pacific to strengthen their merchant propositions beyond core payment acceptance, moving toward platform-led models.

author: PR Newswire (syndicated)
headline: Visa and Mintoak Join Forces to Bring Merchant SaaS Capabilities to Acquirers Across Asia Pacific
snippet: The partnership integrates omnichannel payment acceptance across card-present and card-not-present environments with value-added services such as reporting, merchant engagement tools, and integrated banking solutions.

author: PR Newswire
headline: Visa and Mintoak Join Forces to Bring Merchant SaaS Capabilities to Acquirers Across Asia Pacific
snippet: Acquirers across the Asia Pacific region will gain access to Mintoak's platform-led merchant experience through the new Visa partnership, the companies said.

author: The Paypers Editorial
headline: Visa and Mintoak partner on merchant SaaS for Asia Pacific acquirers
snippet: The collaboration is aimed at helping acquiring banks in Asia Pacific move from transaction-led acquiring to platform-led merchant servicing models.

author: PR Newswire (syndicated)
headline: Visa and Mintoak Join Forces to Bring Merchant SaaS Capabilities to Acquirers Across Asia Pacific
snippet: Visa and Mintoak's partnership will help acquirers deliver a digital-first merchant experience across the Asia Pacific region.

author: CXOToday Desk
headline: Mintoak announces partnership with Axis Bank to enable SMEs with merchant payments and business solutions
snippet: Axis Bank will utilise Mintoak's white-labelled mobile SaaS platform, enabling SMEs to accept payments, access transaction reports, and submit service requests directly through the app.

author: FinTech Magazine Staff
headline: India's fintech SaaS platform Mintoak receives $20mn backing
snippet: Mintoak raised $20 million in a Series A funding round led by PayPal Ventures, as the merchant payments platform looks to scale its bank-embedded SaaS offering.

author: Business Standard Companies Desk
headline: HDFC Bank to acquire 7.75% stake in Mintoak Innovations
snippet: HDFC Bank, India's largest private bank, will acquire a 7.75% stake in Mintoak Innovations on a fully diluted basis for a cash consideration of $3.7 million, as part of a strategic partnership starting with payments.

author: PR Newswire
headline: Mintoak develops merchant solutions to fuel business growth for MSMEs
snippet: Mintoak's modular, API-first merchant platform is designed to help India's MSME merchants access payments, lending, and engagement tools through their banking partners.

author: IndiaInfoline Leaders Speak
headline: Raman Khanduja, Co-founder and CEO, Mintoak Innovations
snippet: In this leadership interview, Mintoak co-founder and CEO Raman Khanduja discusses the company's embedded-fintech strategy and its roadmap for bank partnerships across India, the Middle East and Africa.

author: Axis Bank Corporate Communications
headline: Axis Bank Launches neo for merchants — one-stop solution for the merchant community, in partnership with Visa and Mintoak
snippet: The neo for merchants app, built on Mintoak's platform, empowers merchants to accept payments, view transaction and settlement reports, and raise service requests directly through the mobile app.

author: Adgully Desk
headline: Axis Bank launches neo for merchants with Visa and Mintoak
snippet: Axis Bank has partnered with Visa and merchant SaaS platform Mintoak to launch neo for merchants, a comprehensive one-stop app for Indian SMEs to manage payments and services.

author: Inc42 Newsdesk
headline: Mintoak Closes INR 71 Cr Secondary Deal From Z3Partners
snippet: Merchant payments SaaS platform Mintoak has closed a secondary funding round of INR 71 crore (about $8.2 million), with early-growth investor Z3Partners acquiring a minority stake from existing backers.

author: YourStory Desk
headline: SaaS platform Mintoak closes Rs 71 Cr secondary investment from Z3Partners
snippet: Mintoak has raised Rs 71 crore in a secondary round, with Z3Partners buying a minority stake from initial institutional investors, taking the company's total funding to nearly $25 million.

author: Entrepreneur India Staff
headline: Mintoak Secures INR 71 Cr in Secondary Funding Round Led by Z3Partners
snippet: The Mumbai-based merchant SaaS fintech has welcomed Z3Partners to its cap table via a secondary transaction, as the company continues to scale its bank-embedded payments platform.

author: Business Standard Companies Desk
headline: PayPal-backed Mintoak strikes India's 1st e-rupee deal, worth $3.5 mn
snippet: Mintoak has acquired Bengaluru-based Digiledge in an all-cash deal worth roughly $3.5 million, adding bill-payments and Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC / e-rupee) capabilities to its merchant platform.

author: YourStory Desk
headline: Mintoak acquires Digiledge to expand bill payments and CBDC capabilities
snippet: The acquisition brings blockchain-based bill payments and CBDC infrastructure into Mintoak's platform, letting partner banks including HDFC Bank, Axis Bank and SBI offer e-rupee-related services to merchants.

author: Inc42 Newsdesk
headline: Mintoak Acquires Digiledge To Add CBDC, Bill Payments Capabilities
snippet: Digiledge will operate as a Mintoak subsidiary post-acquisition, strengthening Mintoak's merchant payment offerings and international reach with digital-rupee-ready infrastructure.

author: FinTech Futures Editorial
headline: Mintoak expands into customer loyalty and rewards with ICC Loyalty acquisition
snippet: The acquisition of ICC Loyalty gives Mintoak's banking partners a loyalty and rewards layer on top of its existing merchant payments platform, extending its reach across the Middle East and Africa.

author: PR Newswire
headline: ICC Loyalty joins Mintoak to build a unified Payments and Engagement OS for banks
snippet: Mintoak and ICC Loyalty announced the acquisition, positioning the combined business as a unified payments-and-engagement operating system for banks, spanning payments, loyalty and rewards.

author: IBS Intelligence Editorial
headline: Banks rethink merchant growth: Interview with Raman Khanduja, Co-Founder and CEO at Mintoak
snippet: Khanduja discusses how India's merchant ecosystem is evolving beyond payments adoption toward merchant intelligence, embedded finance and software-led engagement, building on UPI's scale.

author: IBS Intelligence Editorial
headline: Mintoak forays into SEA & MENA regions with strategic appointments
snippet: Mintoak is expanding globally with strategic leadership hires — Chayan Hazra (Kuala Lumpur) driving international expansion, Marlyn Jose targeting growth across Africa, and Jyoti Shankar Mishra driving expansion in the Middle East.

author: CXOToday Desk
headline: Mintoak Expands Global Footprint with Strategic Leadership Appointments
snippet: Mintoak announced three senior leadership hires to accelerate its expansion into Southeast Asia, Africa and the Middle East.

author: Mediabrief Desk
headline: Chayan Hazra, Jyoti Shankar Mishra, Marlyn Jose join Mintoak
snippet: Mintoak expands globally with new leadership hires tasked with driving growth across Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Africa.

author: Entrepreneur India Staff
headline: Meet the Merchant Mate: Raman Khanduja, Co-Founder and CEO, Mintoak
snippet: A profile of Mintoak co-founder and CEO Raman Khanduja, who co-founded the merchant SaaS platform in 2017 alongside Kabeer Jain, Rohit Ramana, Sanjay Nazareth and Rama Tadepalli.

author: Priya Dialani (host)
headline: Digitization and Digital Payments: Expert Insights from Raman Khanduja, MintOak
snippet: A podcast conversation with Mintoak CEO Raman Khanduja on the rise of digital payments, SME empowerment, and the shift toward a mobile-first financial ecosystem.

author: PR Newswire (syndicated)
headline: Mintoak acquires Middle East-headquartered fintech ICC Loyalty
snippet: Syndicated coverage of Mintoak's acquisition of Dubai-based ICC Loyalty, expanding the combined business across the Middle East, Africa, Eastern Europe and Asia.

author: PR Newswire
headline: Mintoak acquires Middle East-headquartered fintech ICC Loyalty
snippet: A second PR Newswire UK release on the ICC Loyalty acquisition, covering the deal's aim to deepen Mintoak's West Asia presence beyond payments into loyalty and rewards.

author: Indian Startup News Desk
headline: Merchant SaaS platform Mintoak buys fintech startup Digiledge
snippet: Syndicated coverage of the Digiledge acquisition, adding bill-payments and CBDC capabilities to Mintoak's merchant SaaS stack.

author: SiliconIndia Desk
headline: Merchant SaaS Platform Mintoak procures Fintech Startup Digiledge
snippet: Coverage of Mintoak's acquisition of Digiledge, positioned as strengthening its digital payments and CBDC capabilities for SME merchants.

author: Elets BFSI Desk
headline: Mintoak Acquires Digiledge to Expand Digital Payment Solutions for SMEs
snippet: Coverage of the Digiledge acquisition from Elets BFSI, framing it as an expansion of Mintoak's digital payment solutions for SME merchants.
